title: Turkish Lamb Lahmacun
description: A flexitarian-friendly Turkish dish featuring lamb, cooking wine, and a jammy sauce, perfect for a date night, served in a lahmacun form and cooked in papillote for a crumbly crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Mix the lamb mince, onion, cooking wine, tomato paste, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and place each part onto a lahmacun bread.
Fold the bread into a square shape and seal the edges.
Place the lahmacun onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and cook in papillote for 20 minutes.
Remove the papillote and top each lahmacun with crumbly feta cheese.
Return the lahmacun to the oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
